name: Everforest Light

provenance.bg.surface: spec: bg1 = Cursor Line, Status Line (active), Tab Line background
provenance.bg.raised: choice: next neutral step above the popup fill bg2 (spec bg3 = inactive tab label background)
provenance.bg.overlay: spec: bg2 = Popup Menu, Floating Window background
provenance.bg.stripe: derived: bg.base darkened to 1.04:1 (weakest fill; bg.inset is too strong here, 1.11:1 vs inactive selection 1.06:1) - zebra rules in layout-archetypes §2.4
provenance.fg.muted: spec: grey2 = Cursor Line Number, Tab Line Label (inactive)
provenance.fg.faint: spec: grey0 = Line Numbers, Foreground UI Elements
provenance.fg.on-accent: spec: bg0 = Tab Line Label (active), drawn on statusline1
provenance.fg.title: spec: orange = Title (vim Title group; ports use fg 2/2)
provenance.border.default: spec: bg4 = Window Splits Separators; consensus inactive border bg4 2/4
provenance.accent.secondary: choice: categorical contrast with green (aqua/blue sit next to green)
provenance.selection.bg: spec: bg_visual = Visual Selection; the menu-selection pair (bg0 on statusline1) is 2.22:1 in Light
provenance.status.success: spec: green = Hint Messages; cross-scheme success = green
provenance.tab.active.bg: spec: statusline1 = Tab Line Label Background (active)
provenance.diff.removed: spec: red = Diff Deleted Signs; consensus 2/2
provenance.diff.changed: spec: blue = Diff Changed Text background; consensus 1/2

notes: No terminal-emulator port is published; ANSI slots come from colors/everforest.vim (black = fg, white = bg3, brights = normals).

Light-theme limit: every Everforest Light accent and grey except fg is below 4.5:1 on bg0 (red 3.04, blue 3.13, green 2.69, yellow 2.12, grey2 3.08). Hard contrast (bg0 #fffbef) helps only marginally.

ansi16 overrides (hue-aware nearest slot that clears the contract floor; dim modelled as 55% blend): status.info -> '4' (slot 6 is 2.79:1; slot 6 #35a77c is not the #3a94c5 hue; slot 4 = #3a94c5, 3.13:1) | accent.primary -> '2' (slot 4 is 3.13:1; slot 4 #3a94c5 is not the #8da101 hue; slot 2 = #8da101, 2.69:1) | border.focus -> '2' (slot 4 #3a94c5 is not the #8da101 hue; slot 2 = #8da101, 2.69:1) | keyhint.key -> '2' (slot 4 is 3.13:1; slot 4 #3a94c5 is not the #8da101 hue; slot 2 = #8da101, 2.69:1) | link -> '2 underline' (slot 4 is 3.13:1; slot 4 #3a94c5 is not the #8da101 hue; slot 2 = #8da101, 2.69:1) | search.match -> '2 bold' (slot 3 is 2.12:1; slot 2 is the closer match to #8da101; slot 2 = #8da101, 2.69:1) | fg.muted -> '8' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.21:1; now 5.18:1) | keyhint.desc -> '8' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.21:1; now 5.18:1) | tab.inactive.fg -> '8' (default 'default dim' resolves to 2.21:1; now 5.18:1) | tab.active.bg -> '2', tab.active.fg -> 'bg bold' (the theme draws a filled active tab: #fdf6e3 on #93b259)
